title: Observability: key_export_public/private log wrong provider field
description: read() KEY_EXPORT_PUBLIC error log (line 539) and ioctl_key_export_private failure log (line 2349) use state->algo/state->provider_name (the OPERATION fd fields, always empty on a KEY fd) instead of state->key_algo/state->key_provider_name. Support engineers see an empty provider string in dmesg and cannot tell which provider's key_export callback failed.
